# EnterpriseGlue v0.16.0 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.15.3`.

## Highlights

- **plugin deployment:** Make the OSS-native Plugin Manager source-free and release-locked for connected container backends with CDN-hosted frontends.
- **release-automation:** Keeps generated technical release documents compliant with the repository publication boundary in pull requests and protected merge groups.

## User and administrator impact

- Operators can enable the isolated Plugin Manager through standard OSS deployment inputs without rebuilding it from source.
- CDN-fronted installations receive an explicit same-origin plugin asset route and readiness contract.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Existing plugin deployments remain supported; adopt the optional digest-pinned Plugin Manager deployment kit when ready.

## API and integration compatibility

- Adds deployment readiness metadata for the native Plugin Manager and same-origin plugin asset route.
- Retains exact compatibility for earlier patch releases within the current supported plugin SDK minor line.

## Configuration

- Adds optional digest-pinned Plugin Manager deployment, persistent plugin state, and CDN/plugin-asset routing configuration.

## Database migrations

- No database migration is planned for this deployment-only slice.
- This release-automation correction does not change application data or migrations.
- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- The Plugin Manager remains an isolated customer-local workload with no browser-facing service.
- Registry and deployment credentials remain outside the browser and ordinary OSS backend.

## Documentation

- Document the supported connected Compose backend and CDN-hosted frontend deployment path and label Kubernetes, OpenShift, and full air-gap delivery as preview.
- Document the separation between internal product planning, repository technical documentation, and customer documentation.
- Generated release documents now declare their technical classification, repository publication target, lifecycle, and operator/developer/maintainer audience.

## Published packages

| Package | Previous | New | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `@enterpriseglue/backend-host` | `0.6.0` | `0.6.1` | patch |
| `@enterpriseglue/plugin-sdk` | `0.3.0` | `0.3.1` | patch |

## Known limitations

- The public enterpriseglue.ai marketplace and commercial entitlement service remain outside this OSS change.
- Kubernetes, OpenShift, multi-replica shared plugin assets, and complete commercial-plugin air-gap delivery remain preview until their deployment matrices pass.

## Rollback

- Disable the optional Plugin Manager workload and continue using the existing installer CLI fallback.
- Restore the previous renderer only together with an explicit release-document exception in the publication boundary guard.

## Validation evidence

- Validate Compose rendering, CDN route contracts, multi-architecture references, signed distribution metadata, and source-free deployment assets.
- Run release-note, documentation-policy, and focused plugin deployment tests.
- Run release-note renderer tests, documentation-boundary tests, release preflight, and the protected merge-group boundary guard.
